The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Cilghal]] maintained her own private '''lab''' in the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the planet of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] at the time of the [[Swarm War]] around [[36 ABY]]. It was presumably built at the time of the academy's construction in [[30 ABY/Legends|30 ABY]].
